requirements.title: Four-course AI concentration
requirements.summary: Four courses: two foundations and two electives. Credit amounts are source credits; unit normalization is unverified.

requirements.title: Parent degree
requirements.summary: BSCS majors may pursue this concentration, effective Fall 2026. This local inventory does not certify the host degree.

requirements.title: Transcript and overlap
requirements.summary: The concentration appears on the transcript, not the diploma. Its courses may also count toward other major or minor requirements.

requirements.title: Declaration
requirements.summary: Declare by submitting a change-of-major form to SEAS.

requirements.title: AI Techniques Elective (3 credits)
requirements.summary: Choose 1 course(s). Topic-specific entries qualify only for the named topics; alternatives are not all required.

requirements.title: AI Applications & Impacts Elective (3 credits)
requirements.summary: Choose 1 course(s). Topic-specific entries qualify only for the named topics; alternatives are not all required.

requirements.title: Approved special-topic offerings
requirements.summary: CS 4501 and MDST 3510 count only for the topics specifically listed in their respective technique or applications categories; generic course enrollment is insufficient.

requirements.title: Enforced course prerequisites
requirements.summary: CS checks published prerequisites and required prerequisite grades at the start of each semester; successful registration alone does not establish eligibility. Individual course prerequisites still need separate verification.

requirements.title: CS elective content overlap
requirements.summary: Two substantially overlapping electives cannot both count toward the CS degree. General 3000-level CS elective eligibility does not expand the concentration’s specifically approved lists.

requirements.title: Internships do not earn CS degree credit
requirements.summary: An internship does not itself earn CS course credit. The special UNST internship courses may support enrollment/visa purposes but do not fulfill degree requirements or the AI concentration.

requirements.title: External study during regular terms
requirements.summary: External coursework during a regular UVA fall/spring semester requires explicit written dean permission to transfer back. The regular-term restriction normally does not apply in summer or J-term; separate school and course approval rules still apply.

requirements.title: SEAS major and minor overlap
requirements.summary: The advising policy reports no SEAS restriction on sharing a course between two majors or a SEAS major and a minor. This does not waive another school’s or credential’s requirements.

requirements.title: Review external courses before enrollment
requirements.summary: For a course absent from the student’s school pre-approved list, request the relevant CS program director’s review before enrollment, including the syllabus and proposed equivalence; then complete school approval paperwork.

requirements.title: Transcript and prerequisite posting
requirements.summary: Send the external institution’s official transcript to the appropriate dean’s office. External work cannot meet a UVA prerequisite until completed and posted with its grade in SIS.

requirements.title: School-specific pre-approved transfer procedure
requirements.summary: For pre-approved courses, SEAS does not require advance course-approval paperwork; follow its post-completion process. The separate written-permission rule for concurrent fall/spring enrollment still applies.
